```sql
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric 
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 
        4
    ) AS answer
FROM staging.stg_logistics__shipments
WHERE region_code = 'AU'
  AND promised_date >= '2025-10-01'
  AND promised_date <= '2026-02-28';
```
